1509.dialogueHTML:
News of Dogran

Speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads.

Description

My mate, Dogran, was recently sent to the Crossroads for duty. It was a promotion, and he was very proud.

I was sad, of course, but I didn't let him know that. And worried, too. The Barrens is a more dangerous place than Orgrimmar, and I feared the worst.

Now it's been a week after he should have returned, and I have received no word from him...

Perhaps you could go to the Crossroads and see if they have any news? He worked with Gazrog, who should still be stationed there.

Completion

Zankaja? That's Dogran's mate, right?

Yeah, I've heard from him, but it's not the sort of news we should let get back to her...

No, he's not dead. But he is injured and a prisoner of the quilboar.
1509.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1510.dialogueHTML:
News of Dogran

Speak with Ken'zigla at the Malaka'jin.

Description

He was stationed at Camp Taurajo, where we've been trying to weed out the quilboar. He led a few grunts to one of their camps, where he was hurt bad. The others made it back and tried to rescue him. He was in bad shape, his wounds festered, so they were afraid to move him without patching him up first.

They sent a message here, requesting a healing draught from the trolls at the Malaka'jin at the base of the Stonetalon Mountains. We sent someone to get it, but they haven't returned yet.

Completion

Another orc, eh? I hope you haven't come for the other. He didn't make it. Those goblins did him in good.

He said he needed a healing draught, but not much else.
1510.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1511.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-horde]Horde[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=2], [race=5], [br][race=8][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=4197/kenzigla]Ken'zigla[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=5911/grunt-logmar]Grunt Logmar[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1511.dialogueHTML:
Ken'zigla's Draught

Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
Ken'zigla's Draught (Provided) (1)

Description

I figured there might be another coming to get the draught, so I prepared it anyways.

Here you go, <name>. Mind you, you should only give half of it to him! That will give him enough strength to move without bleeding himself dry. Wait a night, then give him the other half.

Anyways, you'll want to bring this to Logmar at Camp Taurajo. From what the first one told me, he should have an idea where this Dogran is.

Progress

Yes, what is it?

Completion

Well, it's about time! Dogran has been dying out there, waiting for this.

We need to get this out to him right away, but most of the grunts stationed here are out on a foraging mission.
1511.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1515.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-horde]Horde[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=2], [race=5], [br][race=8][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=5911/grunt-logmar]Grunt Logmar[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=5908/grunt-dogran]Grunt Dogran[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1515.dialogueHTML:
Dogran's Captivity

Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Dogran in the Barrens.
Ken'zigla's Draught (Provided) (1)

Description

You've made it this far, so if you want to see this through to the end, I won't stop you. I can't spare you any additional manpower though, you'll be on your own.

Dogran is being held in a quilboar camp to the north of here. Look for a group of two huts. He'll be heavily guarded--that is, if they haven't killed him yet, or he hasn't succumbed to his wounds.

Good luck.

Progress

Urrrghhhh...

Completion

Foul tasting brew...

I can feel the strength in me now, enough to hobble away... But my leg, I will have lost it for the rest of my life. My arm, too.
1515.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1512.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-horde]Horde[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=2], [race=5], [br][race=8][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=5908/grunt-dogran]Grunt Dogran[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=5875/ganrul-bloodeye]Gan'rul Bloodeye[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1512.dialogueHTML:
Love's Gift

Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Dirt-caked Pendant (Provided) (1)

Description

Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.

Leave me, <name>. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.

And please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.

Progress

You have returned. Are you ready to battle a succubus?

Completion

If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, <name>. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
1512.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1513.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-horde]Horde[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=2], [race=5], [br][race=8][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=5875/ganrul-bloodeye]Gan'rul Bloodeye[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=5875/ganrul-bloodeye]Gan'rul Bloodeye[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1513.dialogueHTML:
The Binding

Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
  •  
Summoned Succubus slain (1)
Dogran's Pendant (Provided) (1)

Description

Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, <name>. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising warlock.

When you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.

Progress

When I look upon a succubus, my heart begins to soar... But at the same time, I can almost sense my soul's ebb, drifting away like the tides.

Be wary, my friend.

Completion

Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

You have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.

Leave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.
1513.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1474.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-horde]Horde[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=2], [race=5], [br][race=8][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=5675/carendin-halgar]Carendin Halgar[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=5675/carendin-halgar]Carendin Halgar[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1474.dialogueHTML:
The Binding

Using the Pure Hearts, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Pure Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
  •  
Summoned Succubus slain (1)
Pure Hearts (Provided) (1)

Description

Using these hearts, cast a spell at the summoning circle to open a doorway for the succubus to come through. Your powers are greater now, and you will need all of them to defeat the succubus.

Beware its charms, <name>, many a strong mind has been bound to its will. When overcome, the succubus will be returned to the void, and I will teach you the spell to summon it forth at your command.

Progress

Of the powers from beyond the void, the succubus is one of the most dangerous, as the weak are most easily wrapped around its fingers.

Remember that now and in the future.

Completion

Again, you have done well, <name>. It has been quite some time since I have seen a young <class> with as much potential as you. Be assured that I will continue to watch your progress, and prepare and assist you in your future trials.

For now, let me show you the summoning spell for your newly dominated succubus.
1474.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1717.dialogueHTML:
Gakin's Summons

Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

Description

<name>! Didn't expect to see you around these parts, but I was instructed to keep an eye out for you.

It's past time you got some more training, so you should stop in to see Gakin the next time you're in Stormwind. He'll be waiting for you.

Completion

I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, <name>. I was beginning to fear the worst. It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you.

We can talk later, though. Your training is the only important thing now.
1717.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1738.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=7][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6244/takar-the-seer]Takar the Seer[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6122/gakin-the-darkbinder]Gakin the Darkbinder[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1738.dialogueHTML:
Heartswood

Retrieve the Heartswood from Ashenvale and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
Heartswood (1)

Description

In preparation for your coming, I used my sight to look over the world and through the mists of time. I have found what it is you seek.

In the War of the Ancients, two lovers fell together in battle. Where they took their last breaths, a tree known as the heartswood grew, a symbol of their undying love.

That should be enough to tempt a succubus. You will find it in the ruins of Ordil'Aran in the northwestern part of the forest of Ashenvale.

Progress

Was your search a success, <name>?

Completion

Yes, I can tell this will do nicely, let me just work with it for a moment...

Takar is a resourceful fellow to have around, isn't he? If only I could persuade him to move back to civilization.
1738.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

1739.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=7][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6122/gakin-the-darkbinder]Gakin the Darkbinder[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6122/gakin-the-darkbinder]Gakin the Darkbinder[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1739.dialogueHTML:
The Binding

Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
  •  
Summoned Succubus slain (1)
Heartswood Core (Provided) (1)

Description

Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.

Be careful, <name>, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.

Once you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.

Progress

Sometimes I wonder if Surena was not a succubus in disguise, sent to warp and twist my mind... Ha! I give her too much credit, I think.

Completion

Well done, well done, <name>. I see we've done right in deciding to train you. Your performance certainly does not disappoint.

I've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. Observe carefully.
1739.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

65602.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=7][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6244/takar-the-seer]Takar the Seer[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6122/gakin-the-darkbinder]Gakin the Darkbinder[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.60.1.69913"]1.60.1[/acronym][/li][/ul]
65602.dialogueHTML:
What Is Love?

Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
Wooden Figurine (1)

Description

You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love. With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual. Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day. Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.

Progress

You've returned. Successfully, I assume?

Completion

<Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.>

I sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey.

Takar never disappoints.
65602.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

65603.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=7][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6122/gakin-the-darkbinder]Gakin the Darkbinder[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6122/gakin-the-darkbinder]Gakin the Darkbinder[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.60.1.69913"]1.60.1[/acronym][/li][/ul]
65603.dialogueHTML:
The Binding

Using the Wooden Figurine, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Wooden Figurine to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
  •  
Summoned Incubus slain (1)
Wooden Figurine (Provided) (1)

Description

The time has come. Take the figurine and descend into the crypts below. A summoning circle has been prepared, and you must place the figurine at its center. Then the gateway will open, and the incubus will cross into our world. A sayaad is not to be underestimated. The demon will not hesitate to attack when it realizes your ruse. You must draw upon all you have been taught to defeat it. If you succeed, return to me and I shall bind the creature to your will. Fail, and your soul is forfeit.

Progress

The incubus will try to lower your guard through beguilement and deception. The demon is adept at swaying the hearts of mortals.

Remember that anything it may offer you is false. To the demon, you are merely prey.

Completion

Not bad, <name>. Your have bested the fiend, and your will remains unbroken.

Many a <class> has believed themselves strong enough to bind a sayaad, only to become the demon's next meal instead. I am pleased to see you are not so foolish.

Watch closely, and I will teach you the invocation to call upon your newly bound incubus.
65603.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

2299.dialogueHTML:
To Hulfdan!

Travel to Ironforge and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard.

Description

Where have you been, <name>? Hulfdan's been looking all over the place for you. We thought the king may have put you in irons.

Get to Ironforge as soon as possible and speak with Hulfdan!

Completion

Keep yer voice down, <name>, the guards may hear ye.
2299.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

2298.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 16[/li][li]Requires level 16[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Class: [class=4][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=5165/hulfdan-blackbeard]Hulfdan Blackbeard[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6946/renzik-the-shiv]Renzik "The Shiv"[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]16[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]19[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]23[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
2298.dialogueHTML:
Kingly Shakedown

Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."

Description

So there we were, about to start plottin' out phase III when a couple o' Magni's blockheads come bargin' in here talkin' bout some kind o' heist and arresting some o' the Hidden Circle.

Well nobody puts the iron on old Blackbeard! The argumentations got heavy and thick and somehow yer name weres blurted out!

Me advice? Take the first Gryphon out o' Ironforge and get to Stormwind. Get yerself to Old Town and once there, talk to an old friend o' mine named Renzik "The Shiv."

Completion

It's always good to have one of Hulfdan's rogues among our ranks!
2298.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

2300.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 16[/li][li]Requires level 16[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Class: [class=4][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=917/keryn-sylvius]Keryn Sylvius[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6946/renzik-the-shiv]Renzik "The Shiv"[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]16[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]19[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]23[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
2300.dialogueHTML:
SI:7

Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."

Description

Renzik was looking for you, fish.

I wouldn't keep Mathias's second in command waiting if I were you.

Completion

Are you ready to get to work or do you need to take a nap before we get started?
2300.sourceReview: Current own-ID, infobox, all five raw English boundaries, full installed record/prerequisites/exclusions and all UA1.1.1 variants inspected. Current eligibility is not live proof.

65593.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 20[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-horde]Horde[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=2], [race=5], [br][race=8][/li][li]Class: [class=9][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=5693/godrick-farsan]Godrick Farsan[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=5675/carendin-halgar]Carendin Halgar[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]27[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.60.1.69913"]1.60.1[/acronym][/li][/ul]
65593.dialogueHTML:
Hearts of the Lovers

Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
Avelina's Heart (1)
Isaac's Heart (1)

Description

An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.

My scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.

In Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.

They toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.

Progress

Ah, <name>, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?

Completion

As expected. Excellently done, <name>.



Idiots.

65597.dialogueHTML:
The Binding

Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
  •  
Summoned Incubus slain (1)
Lovers' Hearts (Provided) (1)

Description

The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.

The demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, <name>. You must subdue it fully.

Only then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.

Progress

The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.

Do not let it, <name>.

Completion

Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a <class> has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.

This trial did not break you, <name>, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.

65601.dialogueHTML:
Love Hurts

Speak with Magar in Orgrimmar.

Description

A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind. The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion. If you trust a blind man to lead you, <name>, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge. Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.

Completion

Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...

65610.dialogueHTML:
Wish You Were Here

Investigate Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Withered Scarf (1)

Description

I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared... They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it. We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts. I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.

Progress

Yes, what is it?

Completion

What is it you have there, <name>? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.

65604.dialogueHTML:
The Binding

Using the Withered Scarf, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Withered Scarf to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
  •  
Summoned Incubus slain (1)
Withered Scarf (Provided) (1)

Description

Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist. Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, <name>. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a warlock's final mistake. When you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.

Progress

The sayaad are dominators of minds and torturers of souls. Their visage brings the heart joy, leaving you defenseless when they rend your flesh with whip and claw.

Do not entertain the incubus' charms, <name>. Slay it quickly and let it be done.

Completion

Hah! Victorious, as expected!

The incubus is subdued, and it will be my pleasure to teach you to summon the demon. You strength is growing, and I have no doubt that this is a mere stepping stone to even greater powers.

I will return the scarf to Magar. I have known that orc for many years, and never did I think he would care for someone the way he cared for Krilge.

It is a reminder of what separates us from the demons. We wield their darkness, but they will never wield us.
